steps.what: List stored safety rules and regulations
Explain safety rules and regulations in person
Enforce those safety rules on the field
Sign the safety note
File the signed safety note
outputs: filed copy of signed safety note v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists stored safety rules and regulations. The coach explains them and enforces them on the field. A later job files the signed note. Enforcement stays with the coach.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safety rules were posted without a date.
tasks.enabler_now: Rule identifier and effective date are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Enforcement on the field stays with the coach.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides when a rule is broken.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week on the field, not on listing rules.

reach.task: Follow only the rule the coach explained

evidence.claim: The executive digest says casting, game strategy, and judging artistry stay with people.

assumptions: Rule identifier and effective date are stored on the safety record. The safety record produces them. A blank effective date means the rule is not listed as current.
Native configuration of the safety record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach explaining safety rules and regulations in person.

incremental.description: Refresh rule identifier and effective date when the safety layout changes, and drop a note the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many effective dates are blank. The high end assumes rule identifier and effective date are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored parent questions with no message
Contact the parents of players in person
Provide information and answer their questions
Sign the parent note
File the signed parent note
outputs: filed copy of signed parent note v1

tasks.design: A job in {EMAIL} lists stored parent questions and sends nothing. The coach contacts the parents and answers the questions. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not send a message.
tasks.previous_blocker: Parents were answered from an unmarked thread.
tasks.enabler_now: Parent identifier and question text are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The conversation stays with the coach.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week with parents, not on listing questions.

reach.task: Hear the answer from the coach, not from a message

evidence.claim: The executive digest says casting, game strategy, and judging artistry stay with people.

assumptions: Parent identifier and question text are stored on the question record. The question record produces them. A blank question is not answered by a message. Filing the note does not send it.
Native configuration of the question record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach contacting the parents of players in person.

incremental.description: Refresh parent identifier and question text when the question layout changes, and drop a note the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many questions are blank. The high end assumes parent identifier and question text are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List unnamed slots for camps and clinics
Arrange skill-improvement courses and training camps
Conduct sports-related clinics and pre-season activities
Sign the activity plan
File the signed activity plan
outputs: filed copy of signed activity plan v1

tasks.design: A job in {CALENDAR} lists unnamed slots for camps and clinics and writes no rank. The coach arranges the courses and camps and conducts the clinics and pre-season activities. A later job files the signed plan in {DOCS}. It does not select a person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Camp dates were agreed in separate conversations.
tasks.enabler_now: Activity date, site, and activity type are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Conducting the activity stays with the coach.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week at the activity, not on listing slots.

reach.task: Attend only the activity the coach signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says casting, game strategy, and judging artistry stay with people.
Digest [S11] says a system that filters or evaluates candidates, including for self-employment, is high-risk. This design does not filter or rank candidates.
Digest [S12] says those duties apply from 2 December 2027.
The executive digest says ranking players to sign fits that high-risk reading. This design does not rank players.

assumptions: Activity date, site, and activity type are stored on the activity record. The activity record produces them. A blank date is not a camp. The list names no athlete and does not rank a try-out.
Native configuration of the activity record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach arranging skill-improvement courses and training camps.

incremental.description: Refresh activity date, site, and activity type when the activity layout changes, and drop a plan the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many activity dates are blank. The high end assumes activity date, site, and activity type are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored equipment names and safety notes
Explain and demonstrate sports and training equipment
Show trampolines or weights in person

tasks.human_edge: The coach decides the equipment is ready to show.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week demonstrating, not on listing names.

reach.task: Use only the demonstration the coach signed

Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.

incremental.description: Refresh equipment name and safety note when the equipment layout changes, and drop a note the coach has not signed.

role.altitude: The coach spends the week on the field, with the athletes, and on the signed note. A stored list, an unnamed slot, and filing that signature can move. The coach still runs the session, chooses the people, and signs the note.
reach: An athlete trains only on the session the coach signed.
A parent sees only the note the coach signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a schedule that names a player the coach did not assign.
Reject a scouting claim that does not restate a stored note.
Reject a letter or an order the coach has not signed.
role.ambitious_version: A signed schedule or report can be filed the same day, and the coach still owns the field.
